scope: Pinned self-contained Android ARM64 libretro build; no guest OS, game, firmware, network backend, or prebuilt library is bundled.

components.evidence: Project and primary file headers explicitly grant GPL version 2 or, at the recipient's option, any later version.
Each staged libretro-common file carries the MIT permission and notice text.
Files carry BSD-3-Clause identifiers or the complete three-clause notice.
File headers explicitly allow LGPL 2.1 or later.
File header explicitly allows GPL version 3 or later.
TinySoundFont carries MIT; SIMDe portions carry MIT and CC0 notices.
The project file remains GPL-2.0-or-later and identifies embedded miniz, Small Deflate, ozunshrink, and Mark Adler material as public domain.

remainingReleaseGates: Two clean path-isolated Android ARM64 builds must be byte-identical.
A redistributable DOS fixture must pass video, audio, input, and repeated state cycles.
Physical-device performance, frame pacing, audio, lifecycle, and Quick Resume must pass.
Windows 9x guest files remain user content and are not part of EmuFusion.
